description: This file defines an interface for sort field expressions used in query construction within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies methods for visitor pattern acceptance tailored to sorting, filtering, and existence checks on fields.

classes.name: SortFieldExpression
classes.description: An interface representing a sort field expression used for defining sorting options in queries, extending filtering and existence expression capabilities, with methods accepting various visitors.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor specifically for sorting operations to perform evaluation or processing.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for filter expressions, inherited from parent interfaces.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for existence expression evaluations, inherited from parent interfaces.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: General method to accept a visitor implementing the FieldExpressionVisitor interface.
